title_sq: Tek Kompleksi "Golden Gate", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Strukture Dhe Hapesira Perfekte !!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi "Golden Gate", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Strukture Dhe Hapesira Perfekte !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 9 banim me hapesira te bollshme. Organizohet nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhomen matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e femijeve dhe tualeti dites. Orientohet nga Bulevardi Bajram Curri me pamje te hapur. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder zonat me te kerkuara, mjaft e qete dhe me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode dhe akses me dalje te menjehershme ne Unazen e Madhe. Apartamenti ka ne dispozicion dhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra 28.000 euro. Objekti aktualisht eshte ne fazen e veshjes se fasades dhe pritet te perfundoje ne pak muaj.
title_en: In "Golden Gate" Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Structures And Spaces!!
description_en: In "Golden Gate" Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Structures And Spaces!! The apartment is located on the 9th residential floor with ample space. It is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the cooking corner and exit to the balcony, the matrimonial room with its own toilet, the children's room and the day toilet. It is oriented from Bajram Curri Boulevard with an open view. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas, quite quiet and with all the facilities for a comfortable life and immediate access to the Great Ring Road. The apartment also has a parking space available at an extra price of 28,000 euros. The building is currently in the phase of cladding the facade and is expected to be completed in a few months.
